cause: the value was written as a hardcoded literal in the sealing script instead of being read from the run log. It was already one print interval stale when sealed.

evidence.method: each progress line carries the runner's own elapsed minutes; added to the process create_time this reconstructs when the line was printed
evidence.conclusion: 120/360 was printed at ~11:08 and the pause was issued at 11:15:33, so the last printed progress at the pause was 120, not 100

why_not_rewritten: PAUSE_V2 is an immutable event record. Correcting it in place would change its digest and destroy the chronology the immutability exists to protect, so the correction is a separate event instead.

impact.on_the_run: NONE — no computation, seed, outcome or protocol is touched by a progress annotation
impact.on_provenance: the pause record now reads with this erratum beside it
impact.reinforces: a progress print is DIAGNOSTIC, not evidence. GANN has no ledger, so even the corrected 120 is only 'last printed' — the true in-memory count at the pause lies between 120 and 139, because progress prints every 20 worlds.

true_inmemory_count_at_pause: between 120 and 139 — not readable, and not guessed
